notes.note: Reviewed the changed lib.rs/Cargo/verification-guide references against the native HTTP diff. The changes are confined to pool selection, profile reads, binary IPC, gzip and scoped native boot; documented installation, channel ports, release/signing, service/sidecar ownership, recovery, notification and verification evidence boundaries are unchanged. No release, installed-shell or physical-device success is inferred from these source changes.

Reviewed the lib.rs-linked native startup, native application signaling and notification-feed sections against the bounded HTTP diff. The transport cache does not alter sidecar proof, readiness tickets, peer transcript/account authority, feed cursor ownership or OS delivery. Current binding/profile validation and host-only credentials remain; the new cost details belong to native-shell-verification. No platform qualification is inferred.

Reviewed the affected credential, transport and currentness claims against the bounded native HTTP diff. Pool reuse includes exact origin, credential reference/digest, authorization epoch and profile revision; pre-request and per-chunk scoped revalidation remains. No relay, account, membership, consent, peer proof or server route admission is widened. Existing platform/hosted evidence limits remain; no new runtime qualification is claimed.

Reviewed the profile/root genesis, trusted-file and independent-reader claims against the new HTTP snapshot lookup. Registry and sidecar ownership code is unchanged. The cache still validates owner/mode and no-follow file access each lookup, detects inode/mtime/ctime changes and refuses malformed/missing files; no lock or genesis durability was removed from writers.

Reviewed the historical-blocker banner and host-custody boundary against the shared broker diff. Android still constructs agents with AndroidSystemResolver; no bearer reaches the WebView and keyring reads remain fresh. Mobile genesis remains durable under the writer lock; initialized reads skip that lock and reject missing/unsafe metadata. Physical Android/iOS behavior remains NOT_VERIFIED.

Reviewed the bounded native credential-broker and scoped Device receipt descriptions against the diff. Bearer custody, command registration, main-window restrictions and receipt/profile revalidation are preserved; response chunks change to raw channel data and uploads to base64. This does not qualify native IPC or physical custody.

Reviewed the historical native resolver failure and retired-watch/current-feed boundaries against the broker pool factory. AndroidSystemResolver and the separate notification-feed path remain. This change makes no new closed-app delivery, current DNS or physical-device qualification claim.
